authoring.note: Jan Evertsenstraat 68-92 (even side; J.F. Staal 1925-27). The ladder-plain row: 2.62 m four-light windows on a regular ~4 m pitch laid out over the whole row, split at the party walls (axis layouts per pand from the measured runs), a glass-block band over the canopy, one coping line.
